review:
Cartoon slapstick on 5x5 with Ro$$ the Cat and Maxx the Mouse. The Wild Cat drops down into an expanding wild that can cover its whole reel – and if it swallows a regular wild on the way, that wild's multiplier transfers to the whole cat.

The Ro$$ bonus brings more Wild Cats, and the higher tier is where the multipliers stack. Clear goal: long cats eating multiplier wilds. Medium volatility, 12,500x max, 96.22% RTP. Rad Maxx and Hot Ross build on the same characters.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.02% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
